stale_model_findings.detail:
claim USES-OLD sits at model OLD, which was superseded by NEW.
  The claim is live and its anchor is not. Whatever the new model changed -- what it IS, its ring, its generators -- this claim was written against the old reading and nothing has re-examined it.
stale_model_findings.discharge: If the claim still holds at NEW, supersede it with the model field repointed -- that is a RESTATE, because the model is part of what identifies a claim. If it does not, retract it. If the model supersession was itself a mistake, supersede the model back rather than leaving two live readings of one object.
